'''Sardonne Sardon''' was a [[Lawyer/Legends|lawyer]]. She was present at the [[Trial of Tahiri Veila]] in its later stages, defending [[Tahiri Veila]] along with [[Eramuth Bwua'tu]].

==Behind the scenes==
Sardonne Sardon's portrayal in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]'' is rather inconsistent in terms of [[Species/Legends|species]]. When she is first introduced on page 160 of the novel, she is identified as a [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. However, in a scene later in the novel, she is described as a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]], complete with the species' dorsal spines, face scales, small claws on her fingers, and usage of pheromones to manipulate others' emotions. This discrepancy has not yet been addressed.
